acceptanceCriteria: A current resource-bound PR with an active matching Contract still selects that active Contract and runs the existing Contract-aware gate.
A historical archived resource-bound PR is selected only by exact branch/PR identity and a valid archive manifest; the Rust gate is PR-only, read-only, and never changes mutable lifecycle evidence.
An archived no-resource PR and an ordinary main push without an active binding use the ordinary repository route without requiring a semantic Release tag or Contract base.
A tag push and explicit immutable-tag recovery remain active-Contract-only and fail closed on missing, archived, ambiguous, or mismatched identity.
The route and gate fail closed on archive manifest, Contract digest, repository, base, symlink, active/archive collision, or identity mismatch.
English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese lifecycle guidance states the same conditional order and historical archived-PR exception.
Regression tests cover active, historical archived resource-bound, archived no-resource, ordinary merge, tag, recovery, collision, and read-only no-write boundaries.
goal: Separate no-resource ordinary archived routes from historical resource-bound PR routes, validate archived identity and manifest bindings in a Rust read-only gate, and remove contradictory lifecycle instructions that cause agents or CI to skip governance or retry from the wrong stage.
intent: Make archived historical PR quality checks explicit and read-only while preserving active Contract governance for current resource-bound Work Items.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A current resource-bound pull request selects exactly its matching active Contract and runs the existing Contract-aware gate.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: active resource-bound pull request selects its active Contract
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the resolver and hosted-route regression with an active branch and pull-request binding, then inspect the selection and gate receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A historical pull request selects an archived Contract only through exact branch and pull-request identity plus a valid archive manifest; the Rust gate remains pull-request-only and performs no mutable lifecycle writes.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: historical resource-bound pull request uses a read-only archived Contract gate
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run a Rust and shell regression using a valid archived resource-bound Contract, then compare all .ai bytes before and after the gate.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An archived Contract without an external resource does not force a historical governance gate; the pull request uses the ordinary repository route.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: archived no-resource pull request remains on the ordinary repository route
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the resolver regression with an archived no-resource Work Item and inspect the selection method and route receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An ordinary push to the main branch with no matching active Contract selects the ordinary merge route and does not apply Release-tag validation.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: ordinary main push does not require a Contract or Release tag
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the main-push resolver and workflow convergence regression with an empty merged-PR result and verify the typed ordinary route.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Tag pushes and explicit immutable-tag recovery reject missing, archived, ambiguous, or mismatched Contract identity before any expensive gate execution.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: tag and explicit recovery routes remain active-Contract-only
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the tag and recovery resolver matrix with active, archived, missing, and ambiguous bindings and inspect each structured failure.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A collision between active and archived Contracts, or any repository, base, digest, symlink, branch, or pull-request mismatch, produces one deterministic blocking diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: active and archived identity collisions fail closed
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run collision and tamper fixtures through the shell resolver and Rust Contract gate, confirming no fallback to an ungoverned ordinary route.

scenarioCoverage.expected: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, AGENTS.md, and .ai/README.md state the same resource-bound versus no-resource order and archived pull-request exception.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the documentation parity and workflow guidance tests, then compare the normalized lifecycle assertions across all declared documents.
